additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0439436 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Based on the reported issue, please schedule a site visit and follow the steps below to resolve it.
For this error -
d-plc: selftestError
true:
Early warning of possible Dispenser PLC cooling fans malfunctioning,
Note: The self-test is performed at each boot-up of the dispenser where the cooling fans are power-cycled on-off from dispenser-PLC for multiple times in short duration cycles. If the ok signal reported by fan is lost even after a delay of ON command to the fan, it denotes self test error
Possible solutions:
Check Electrical Wiring
: Inspect the electrical wiring of the cooling circuit for tightness.
Inspect Cooling Air Filters
: Ensure that the cooling air filters are clean and not obstructed.
Perform Preventive Maintenance
: Conduct preventive maintenance and perform multiple reboots. If the self-test fails, it could be an early indication that the cooling fan may fail in the future. It is recommended to start considering spare parts.
For this error -
PowerConverters
We recommend going through the KA below. After checking this, if the issue persists, please consider replacement.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - (dynamics.com)
